name: Japan Masters
stakes: This Super 500 event is a vital opportunity for India's shuttlers to gain crucial ranking points and build confidence as the season progresses.
summary:
The Japan Masters Super 500 event has begun with a promising start for India's contingent, particularly in doubles. The dynamic women's doubles pair of Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand have confidently sailed into the Round of 16, securing a straight-games victory in their opening match. In men's doubles, Hariharan Amsakarunan and M.R. Arjun also advanced to the next round, benefiting from their opponents' retirement.

India's top men's doubles duo, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, seeded fourth, are poised to begin their campaign, aiming to assert their dominance. Olympic medalist PV Sindhu, a consistent force in women's singles, will be looking for a deep run to gather crucial momentum. Other key players like veteran HS Prannoy and rising talent Malvika Bansod are also in the draw, eager to make their mark in this significant tournament.
